import re
from datetime import datetime

with open("jetnet_logs.txt", "r") as file:

for line in lines:
    if not line:
        continue
    user_id = re.findall(r"@User(\d+):", line)[0]
    actions = re.findall(r"Action_\d+ \(\d{2}/\d{2}/\d{2} \| \d{2}:\d{2}:\d{2}\)(?: -->)?", line)

        action_name, action_time = re.findall(r"(Action_\d+) (\(\d{2}/\d{2}/\d{2} \| \d{2}:\d{2}:\d{2}\))", action)[0]

import pandas as pd
import re
from datetime import datetime



with open("jetnet_logs.txt", "r") as file:
    content = file.read()

lines = content.split('\n')
user_ids, session_nums, action_times, action_names = [], [], [], []

session_num = 0
for line in lines:
    if not line:
        continue
    session_num += 1
    user_id = re.findall(r"@User(\d+):", line)[0]
    actions = re.findall(r"Action_\d+(?: \(\d{2}/\d{2}/\d{2} ?\| ?\d{2}:\d{2}:\d{2}\))?", line)
    
    for action in actions:
        action_info = action.split(" ")
        action_name = action_info[0]
        action_time = re.findall(r"\(?(\d{2}/\d{2}/\d{2} ?\| ?\d{2}:\d{2}:\d{2})\)?", action)[0]
        if action_time:
            action_time = datetime.strptime(action_time, "(%d/%m/%y | %H:%M:%S)")
        else:
            action_time = None
        
        user_ids.append(user_id)
        session_nums.append(session_num)
        action_times.append(action_time)
        action_names.append(action_name)

df = pd.DataFrame({
    "user_id": user_ids,
    "session_num": session_nums,
    "action_time": action_times,
    "action_name": action_names
})

from transformers import AutoModel, AutoTokenizer



def get_embeddings(model, tokenizer, current_input):
    if isinstance(current_input, int):
        return np.zeros((1, model.config.hidden_size))

    encoded_input = tokenizer(current_input, return_tensors="pt", truncation=True, padding=False)
    
    with torch.no_grad():
        model_output = model(input_ids=encoded_input.input_ids.to(model.device),
                             attention_mask=encoded_input.attention_mask.to(model.device),)
        token_embeddings = model_output[0]
        input_mask_expanded = encoded_input["attention_mask"].unsqueeze(-1).expand(token_embeddings.size()).float().to(model.device)
        embeddings = torch.sum(token_embeddings * input_mask_expanded, 1) / torch.clamp(input_mask_expanded.sum(1), min=1e-9)
        return F.normalize(embeddings, p=2, dim=1).cpu().numpy()


def concat_text(df: pd.DataFrame, text_columns) -> pd.DataFrame:
    df = df.copy()

    for col in text_columns:
        df[col] = df[col].apply(lambda x: "\n".join(x) if isinstance(x, list) else x)
    return df


def process_X_text(X: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    X.loc[X["text/plain"] > 200, "text/plain"] = -1
    X.loc[X["execute_result"] > 200, "execute_result"] = -1
    X = X.drop(columns=["cell_type"])
    X = concat_text(X, text)
    
    embeddings = {}
    for col in ["text", "comment", "code_line_before", "code_line_after", "markdown_heading"]:
        print(f"Building embeddings for {col}")
        embeddings[col] = np.array([get_embeddings(model, tokenizer, ex)[0] for ex in X[col]])
    X = X.drop(columns=text)
    for col in embeddings:
        X = pd.concat((X, pd.DataFrame(embeddings[col])), axis=1)
    return X
